name: paste-negative-reals-on
description: Paste Ability of an object holding negative reals, with Allow negative real values on as File > Preferences writes it ([Object Editor] Allow Negative Values=true; the box asks 'Are you sure you want to allow negative values?' first; 2026-11-19): negative-reals.w3x (tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-negative-reals.mjs: custom Heal A000, Cooldown -3, -1.5, 2, Casting Time -0.5, Cast Range -100), the Object Editor (F6) on Abilities, End and six Right keys select the custom Heal, Edit > Copy Ability, Edit > Paste Ability, the Object ID dialog's default id (A001) taken with Return: A001 comes with every negative unchanged, as Studio's Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V (objectedit.ts pastedObject)

steps.eval: await w3.commands.execute('w3.objectEditor.open', 'w3a', 'A000'); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !document.querySelector('.obj-list'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const list = document.querySelector('.obj-list'); list.focus(); list.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'c', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); list.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'v', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: paste-negative-reals-off
description: The same with Allow negative real values off (Allow Negative Values=false): the editor's Paste Ability keeps the negatives too (2026-11-19), and Studio's paste, with its setting off

steps.eval: await w3.commands.execute('w3.objectEditor.open', 'w3a', 'A000'); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !document.querySelector('.obj-list'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const list = document.querySelector('.obj-list'); list.focus(); list.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'c', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); list.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'v', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); await w3.editors.saveAll();
